bio: A drop-dead wine list, a knock-out collection of authentic local brews and updated family favourites to share: this bustling restaurant on Lennik market square attracts foodies like bees to honey! They swarm here for shrimp fritters, grilled loin of pork with a light frothy béarnaise sauce and piping-hot crunchy French fries cooked in beef fat, without forgetting grilled seabass and a host of other delectable morsels. Exuberant home-style cooking that shines the spotlight on local produce courtesy of textbook know-how. Ten out of ten!...
